subtopics.title: Comparative vs. Absolute Evaluation
subtopics.summary: Distinguishes ranking models against each other from measuring whether a model is good enough for a specific use case, noting that comparative results alone cannot determine absolute quality.

subtopics.title: Ranking Models via Pairwise Comparisons
subtopics.summary: Describes how models are evaluated side-by-side to compute a ranking from comparison results, including its use in leaderboards and subjective quality assessment.

subtopics.title: Scalability Bottlenecks in Comparative Evaluation
subtopics.summary: Covers the quadratic growth of model pairs as the number of models increases and the resulting data-intensity challenges for gathering sufficient comparison signals.

subtopics.title: Signal Gathering and Model Ranking Challenges
subtopics.summary: Addresses difficulties in collecting reliable comparison signals and computing accurate rankings, including the role of human and AI evaluators.
